hypothesis: With unchanged local model weights, sampling, reasoning/output budgets and original seed, test whether model-selected terrain inspection, verified elapsed campaign time and recoverable dialog feedback enable more effective autonomous fortress development and sustained year-two play. This is a fresh exploratory condition, not a repaired continuation or a strict single-variable comparison.
notes: Declared before model execution. Start a new campaign identity from the original immutable seed; preserve the prior failed campaign, its later committed actions and all returned usage. Never resume checkpoint 80 as the old campaign's terminal state.

Keep the reasoning-budget-v1 weights, pinned llama.cpp build, 2048 reasoning tokens within 4096 total output tokens, context size, packing, sampling, step/segment envelope and checkpoint intervals unchanged. Only the declared action/observation profile pair and descriptive metadata change in this configuration.

Use a frozen implementation containing native-validated map inspection and selection save/load, elapsed-time observations and dialog feedback. The historical baseline ran before these implementation changes; this bundle is exploratory and does not isolate the effect of VIEW alone.

The model chooses all VIEW regions/z-levels, world actions and dialog keys. There is no injected starting view, scripted game strategy, auto-dismissal, coordinate correction, human rescue or replay of fixture decisions.

VIEW is terrain-only and zero-tick; it still consumes a decision and model tokens. Hidden/unreadable blanks are not empty floor. Track the model's inspection choices and their subsequent development outcomes, not merely VIEW acceptance.
Preserve every response, actual native tick receipt and cumulative usage. Continue only digest-verified clean checkpoint boundaries without changing condition identity or silently resetting budgets.

Evaluate endurance, native population, installed/completed structures, resources with completeness qualifiers, adaptations after rejection and per-action/total cost. Acceptance is not completed work, stock level is not production, and time survived is not a functioning fortress.

Use one existing local model/game owner at a time with mandatory teardown. No hosted fallback, cloud VM or production deployment. Model API charges are zero; hardware, electricity, application and CI costs are unmeasured.

A functioning fortress after 403200 elapsed native ticks and continued year-two play remain gameplay requirements. This one exploratory run is not a model ranking; comparable repeated attempts across at least three supported models and verified website/remote delivery remain required.
